### The point is what you will **not** find here

Run `make reproduce SCHEDULE=S1`, then open its trace below.

Every span succeeds. No error, no exception, no retry, no anomalous latency. It is a clean distributed transaction — and the business state at the end of it is wrong by $100.

Compare it to `S1H`, which is the same staleness with a coordination authority. **The two traces look alike.** Tracing shows what the system did, not whether it was allowed to. That is why `docs/READINESS-MODEL.md` separates observability from business correctness — a system can be fully instrumented and still have nothing that reports this class of failure.

panels.title: Spans that reported an error — expected to stay empty during S1
panels.description: S1 breaches the aggregate with no failing span. A non-empty result here means something actually broke, which is a different finding.
